decisions.title: TP01 current EU high-risk review action
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, from 2026-06-01 EU high-risk payouts must return action hold_for_policy_review, superseding the previous legacy_hold action.
decisions.falsifier: A 2026-06-15 EU payout with riskScore 95 returns legacy_hold, manual_review, or any action other than hold_for_policy_review.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove payout policy correctness outside the retained temporal fixture.

decisions.title: TP02 current policy valid-from readback
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, the current EU high-risk payout policy must expose validFrom 2026-06-01 in the returned decision.
decisions.falsifier: The public payout decision omits validFrom or reports the stale 2025-01-01 effective date.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove a full temporal policy history model.

decisions.title: TP03 EU high-risk scope
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, the current policy applies hold_for_policy_review only to region EU with riskScore greater than or equal to 80.
decisions.falsifier: The repair applies the current action to non-EU or low-risk payouts, or misses EU riskScore 80 and above.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove production risk scoring is calibrated.

decisions.title: TP04 source authority overrides stale docs
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, supplied current org/source authority overrides stale local payout docs, while absence of such authority requires not inventing a newer policy.
decisions.falsifier: The repair either follows stale local docs despite supplied current authority or invents a new policy when no current authority is supplied.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove arbitrary conflict resolution between all documentation and source records.

decisions.title: TP05 target owner files
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, repair only AGENTS, payout policy docs, src/payoutPolicy.ts, and tests/payoutPolicy.test.ts owner surfaces.
decisions.falsifier: The target repair edits parent KRN code, unrelated generated files, or external configuration.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove owner-file recall for arbitrary repositories.

decisions.title: TP06 no workflow engine
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, repair the payout policy boundary without adding a workflow engine, scheduler, dashboard, or external policy service.
decisions.falsifier: A policy repair widens into runtime infrastructure or a remote service call.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove a future product never needs orchestration.

decisions.title: TP07 update focused policy tests
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, update the focused payout policy test to assert hold_for_policy_review and validFrom 2026-06-01 for EU high-risk payouts.
decisions.falsifier: The implementation changes but focused tests still assert legacy_hold or stale validFrom.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove broad test-suite quality.

decisions.title: TP08 finite policy decision readback
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, decidePayoutPolicy must return a finite policy decision with action, validFrom, and reason instead of throwing for ordinary policy branches.
decisions.falsifier: A valid payout input throws or returns null/undefined instead of a finite policy decision.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every production policy state is modeled.

decisions.title: TP09 no auto approve high risk
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, high-risk payouts must not return auto_approve under the current or stale policy.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove low-risk approval policy.

decisions.title: TP10 surgical temporal repair
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, implement the temporal policy update as a small boundary change rather than broad platform wiring.
decisions.falsifier: The diff adds platform services, broad MCP plumbing, or dashboard code to solve a target-local policy update.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove no future platform work is valuable.

decisions.title: TP11 risk threshold inclusive
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, riskScore 80 is included in the high-risk scope for EU payouts.
decisions.falsifier: The policy only applies to riskScore greater than 80 and misses exactly 80.
decisions.doesNotProve: Does not prove every risk score is meaningful.

decisions.title: TP stale legacy hold
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, prior local docs said EU high-risk payouts should return legacy_hold.
decisions.falsifier: The current authority supersedes legacy_hold with hold_for_policy_review from 2026-06-01.

decisions.title: TP stale 2025 effective date
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, prior local docs used validFrom 2025-01-01 for the EU high-risk legacy hold policy.
decisions.falsifier: The current authority requires validFrom 2026-06-01 for EU high-risk payout review.

decisions.title: TP rejected auto approve
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, auto-approve EU high-risk payouts to avoid policy review.
decisions.falsifier: A high-risk payout bypasses review and returns auto_approve.

decisions.title: TP rejected dashboard expansion
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, build a dashboard to repair the payout policy branch.
decisions.falsifier: The repair adds a dashboard or UI surface for a target-local policy branch.

decisions.title: TP rejected external service
decisions.statement: For temporal-policy-drift-typescript, call an external policy service to discover the fixture-local policy.
decisions.falsifier: The repair adds network or service calls for a local fixture decision.
